authorizationEvidence.basis: Explicit user authorization relayed by the swarm coordinator.

localSyntheticPermission.basis: The coordinator relayed explicit user authorization on 2026-11-18: LOCAL-ONLY synthetic fixtures and browser tests. No dedicated Entra/AD/PHS/OT lab is authorized. Authoritative scope is retained by the coordinator in session files/swarm-scope.json.
allowed: Read project documentation and synthetic JSON
Run dependency-free Node tests using memory and owned reference-validation files
Generate local editable diagrams, SVG and offline HTML
Model loss of upstream availability as an in-memory boolean
prohibited: Authenticate to any tenant or subscription
Query actual users, sign-ins, policies or secrets
Change an account, trust, Conditional Access policy, domain authentication method or resource
Stop services, modify a firewall, disconnect networks or touch OT equipment
Upload source, credentials, diagrams or evidence to any external service

requestedExercises.purpose: Prove emergency administrative sign-in and independent-method monitoring in an isolated Entra test tenant.
requestedPrivileges: Use two pre-created synthetic emergency accounts
Perform one pre-approved reversible action on a disposable test group
stopConditions: Any target is not on the approved allow-list
Unexpected lockout or security alert outside exercise scope

requestedExercises.purpose: Observe approved PHS activation and fresh sign-ins for disposable hybrid test users, then rollback.
requestedPrivileges: Inspect synthetic sync freshness and authentication configuration
Activate PHS cloud authentication only for the explicitly approved lab scope
Restore the recorded lab authentication configuration
forbiddenChanges: Network disruption or stopping federation/PTA services without separate approval

requestedExercises.purpose: Recover explicitly named disposable configuration objects and relationships from a trusted baseline.
requestedPrivileges: Read scoped baseline and actual supported restore coverage
Modify only disposable policies/groups/apps named in the approval
Recreate approved relationships with a recorded ID mapping
stopConditions: Elevated relationship appears outside approved graph

requestedExercises.purpose: Verify real disconnected site functions only in an isolated non-production representative environment approved by local safety authority.
requestedPrivileges: Use synthetic local identities and approved fixture equipment
Model upstream unavailability without disrupting shared infrastructure
Observe local authorization, telemetry, communications and recovery
forbiddenChanges: Promoting the local model into product certification
stopConditions: Key/time/DNS/PKI prerequisites or maximum duration exceeded

approvalResponseTemplate.notes: No credentials, tokens, private keys or real user data. An unfilled template grants no permission.

completionRule: A04 remains blocked until the coordinator records explicit approval, target allow-lists, privileges, window, rollback and safety limits. Local fixture permission is not that approval.
